families.name: Compressed Air Treatment
families.title: Compressed Air Treatment Equipment | Win Equipments
families.description: Refrigerated and desiccant air dryers, compressed air filters, drain valves, air receivers and aftercoolers manufactured by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.
families.lede: Dry, clean compressed air protects machines, valves and finished product. We make every stage of the treatment line, from the aftercooler at the compressor to the dry air receiver at the plant header.
families.summary: Dryers, filters, drains and receivers for dry, clean compressed air.

families.name: Process Cooling
families.title: Industrial Chillers & Process Cooling | Win Equipments
families.description: Process chillers from 0.5 to 20 TR, engineered chillers, heat exchangers and condensing units, built by Win Equipments in Coimbatore.
families.lede: Process chillers hold water at a set temperature so moulds, presses, baths and machines run at a steady temperature. Standard WCP chillers cover 0.5 to 20 TR; special duties are engineered to order.
families.summary: Chillers that hold process water at a set temperature.

families.name: Cooling Towers
families.title: FRP & Coil Cooling Towers, Coimbatore | Win Equipments
families.description: Round and square FRP cooling towers 10–300 TR and coil cooling towers 40–280 TR, plus cooling tower spares. Manufactured by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.
families.lede: Cooling towers reject process heat to the atmosphere. FRP towers cool water by evaporation to wet bulb + 4 °C; coil towers keep water sealed in a finned coil and cool it to ambient + 4 °C.
families.summary: FRP and coil towers that reject process heat to atmosphere.

industries.name: Plastics & injection moulding

industries.title: Chillers & Cooling Towers for Plastics | Win Equipments
industries.description: Process chillers and FRP cooling towers for injection moulding, blow moulding and plastic machinery. Built by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.

industries.name: Textile, spinning & knitting mills

industries.title: Air Dryers & Cooling Towers for Textile Mills | Win
industries.description: Refrigerated air dryers, FRP cooling towers and coil cooling towers for spinning, weaving and knitting mills. Built by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.

industries.name: Automotive & CNC machine shops
industries.intro: Automotive plants and CNC machine shops depend on dry, clean compressed air for tools and automation, and on chilled water for machines and hydraulics.
industries.title: Air Dryers & Chillers for CNC Machine Shops | Win
industries.description: Refrigerated air dryers, process chillers and cooling towers for automotive plants and CNC machine shops. Built by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.

industries.name: Food, dairy & beverage
industries.intro: Food processing, dairies, soft-drink plants and breweries use chilled water, flake ice and cooling towers, and dry compressed air for packaging and process lines.
industries.title: Chillers & Air Dryers for Food & Dairy | Win Equipments
industries.description: Process chillers, ice flake machines, refrigerated air dryers and cooling towers for food, dairy and beverage plants. Win Equipments, Coimbatore.

industries.name: Pharma & chemical
industries.intro: Chemical and pharmaceutical plants need process cooling that suits the fluid, closed-loop cooling that keeps water clean, and dry compressed air.
industries.title: Chillers & Air Dryers for Pharma & Chemical | Win

industries.intro: Cement plants, paper mills and sugar factories run large compressed air systems and process cooling loops.
industries.title: Air Dryers & Cooling Towers for Cement & Sugar | Win
industries.description: Compressed air dryers, process chillers and cooling towers for cement, paper and sugar plants. Built by Win Equipments, Coimbatore.

process: Compressor CFM, heat load in TR or water flow, temperatures and site conditions. A drawing or nameplate photo helps.
Our engineers select the model from catalogue ratings and correction factors, or engineer a special unit.
Fabricated and assembled at our works in Arasur, Coimbatore.
Chillers are factory tested before delivery; air receivers are hydrostatically tested.
We plan and commission the system, then provide after-sales service and spares.
